configuration: Runs the physical scenario represented by code/mrsimulator/examples_source/1D_simulation(macro_amorphous)/plot_4_amorphous_like_quad.py with a check-specific isotope, tensor, sampling and spectrum configuration.
observable: Physical complex frequency-domain spectrum samples only (real and imaginary components); input parameters and timing are not graded.
variant: Variant changes the active shielding tensor by 1e-7 ppm and, for spinning cases, the rotor frequency; only spectrum samples are graded.

evidence.floor_how: Measured by sab.py task selfcheck on the final nominal/variant spectra.

altbuild: none: no independent compiler floor declared.
warrant: The spectrum is the physical observable asserted by the upstream scenario. Pointwise comparison over all complex samples catches missing transitions, wrong tensor rotations, frequency shifts and normalization errors while excluding inputs and metadata.
